summary: The proposed patch changes the condition from strict equality to less than one, which may not fully address the root cause of the issue and could introduce unexpected behavior.

issues.description: The patch changes the condition from `len(constraint_names) != 1` to `len(constraint_names) < 1`, which may not fully address the root cause of the issue and could introduce unexpected behavior.
There are no additional tests provided to verify the correctness of the change, which increases the risk of introducing regressions.
